context.source: Same original published EURUSD price records; chart context only

source: INFINITECH/JRC published EURUSD original single-price ticks
sampling: All 714 original single-price observations in the declared source-clock window; all 238 preceding observations for chart context only. No interpolation, resampling or reconstructed bid/ask/volume.
timestampSemantics: floating source-clock coordinate; timezone and bid/ask side unreported
transformation: Original five-decimal USD-per-EUR prices encoded exactly at 1e5. Original MM/DD/YYYY source clock mapped to a floating numeric chart coordinate, not UTC. Source ordinals and original fields retained; Up/Down are not treated as traded volume.

rights.attribution: Georgios Fatouros (INNOV ACTS LTD) and Konstantina Tripodi (JRC Capital Management Consultancy & Research GmbH), High frequency (tick data) of historical FOREX prices, version 1.0.1, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.7411148, CC BY 4.0. Selected window/context and exact integer price encoding by Market Endgames; fictional accounts/execution added. No author endorsement.

limitations: Original publisher numerical compilation under its primary CC BY 4.0 grant; the originating API feed is not identified and full underlying vendor-rights certification is not claimed.
Source timezone, quote side and executable status are unreported. Do not align these coordinates with UTC or timed news, or label values bid/ask.
Orders, capacity, routing, zero fees and cash settlement are fictional. No executable spread, queue, brokerage financing or real trading return is modeled.
The original EURUSD member omits the entire February 2022 period; the initially requested February 24 window is not available. Missing records are not interpolated.
